# BuildSignals

> BuildSignals books in-home appointments for residential bathroom remodelers in the United States. BuildSignals pays for the ads, calls every homeowner in under 5 minutes and books appointments with every decision-maker home. Remodelers pay $297 per sat appointment from a prepaid balance, and no-shows are free. One bath company per area. No long-term contracts. $2.8M+ in remodeling work generated for contractor clients. Founded by Leo Melaye in 2016; based in Davis, California.

## The offer

- $297 per sat appointment: the remodeler's rep sits with every decision-maker in the home. Ad spend is included.
- Not billed: no-shows, cancellations, reschedules, one-legs (only one decision-maker home), appointments the remodeler chooses not to run, and homeowners already in the remodeler's CRM in the last 90 days.
- Prepaid balance: $5,940 opens the account and covers the first 20 sat appointments. The remodeler tops up when the balance runs low.
- Stop any time with 7 days' notice. Unused appointments are refunded.
- 10x guarantee: if the jobs signed from the first 20 sits add up to less than 10 times what was paid ($59,400) within 90 days, BuildSignals adds 10 sits free.
- One bath company per area, in writing.
- CRM integration is free. For remodelers without a CRM, BuildSignals builds one for $1,500.

## What BuildSignals does

- Writes, designs, pays for and runs Facebook and Instagram ads for the remodeler's service area
- Calls every new lead in under 5 minutes and screens it against the remodeler's criteria
- Books appointments on the remodeler's calendar and confirms every decision-maker will be home
- Sends every lead and call recording into the remodeler's CRM

## Who it is for

- Residential bathroom remodeling companies with 3 or more people running in-home appointments and 40 or more demos a month
- Bathrooms only: full remodels, tub-to-shower conversions, walk-in showers and tubs, and bath replacements

## Results

- $2.8M+ in residential remodeling work generated for contractor clients to date
- Valencia Construction Pros: $264,025 closed from 11 jobs since July 2026, on $4,380 in ads
- H. Flores Construction: $63,299 closed from 5 jobs since July 2026, on $3,872 in ads
- MTR Baths: $275,000 closed this year on $16,000 in ads
- A Los Angeles remodeler: 71 booked bathroom appointments from BuildSignals ads in its first five weeks
